heading.en: Alma and Amulek are imprisoned and smitten—The believers and their holy scriptures are burned by fire—These martyrs are received by the Lord in glory—The prison walls are rent and fall—Alma and Amulek are delivered, and their persecutors are slain. About 82–81 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua falepuipui ma sasaina Alema ma Amoleka—Ua susunu i le afi e na talitonu faatasi ma a latou tusitusiga paia—Ua talia e le Alii nei maturo i le mamalu—Ua vete ma pa'u'ū i lalo pa o le falepuipui—Ua lavea'iina Alema ma Amoleka, ma ua fasiotia e na sauaina i laua. E tusa o le 82–81 T.L.M.
